tools.name: api_create_key
tools.description: Create a GolfCore Course Data API key for the signed-in person's account. Returns the secret once; hand it to the person to store in their server's configuration, and never put it in chat logs, code, a mobile app or browser code. Confirm the name with the person first.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "subscribe_premium" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
